'''Guon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Private Guon appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Belsavis Modification Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock, though he was later relabeled as the Level 42 Modification Vendor.<ref name="TOR" />
